Completato il laboratorio DNS.

- Impostate immagini `kathara/bind` solo per `pc1`, `pc3`, `pc5`, `pc7`, `pc9`.
- Configurate root, `test.`, secondario AXFR limitato a `pc5`, e `services.test.`.
- Configurato `pc9` come resolver ricorsivo con root hints interni, senza forwarder e con DNSSEC validation disabilitata.
- Configurato `pc11` con il solo resolver `10.33.1.10`.
- Nessuna modifica a topologia, indirizzi, gateway, routing o `/etc/hosts`.

File principali: [lab.conf](/private/var/folders/84/zz92dr1178v8z_tvd_q2dfw40000gn/T/kathara-aut-ltuakwl_/lab/lab.conf), [zona root](/private/var/folders/84/zz92dr1178v8z_tvd_q2dfw40000gn/T/kathara-aut-ltuakwl_/lab/pc1/etc/bind/db.root), [zona test](/private/var/folders/84/zz92dr1178v8z_tvd_q2dfw40000gn/T/kathara-aut-ltuakwl_/lab/pc3/etc/bind/db.test), [zona services](/private/var/folders/84/zz92dr1178v8z_tvd_q2dfw40000gn/T/kathara-aut-ltuakwl_/lab/pc7/etc/bind/db.services.test).
